name: strata
description: STRATA Physics-Informed Spatio-Temporal Deep Learning Framework

scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix web run dev" ".venv/bin/python -m uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir python"
scripts.check: npm --prefix web run check && PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python -m pytest python/tests -q && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check python && .venv/bin/python -m mypy --config-file python/pyproject.toml python/strata python/api && node scripts/check-no-comments.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix web run test -- --run --coverage && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:contract: npm --prefix web run test -- --run src/engine/contract.test.ts src/engine/golden.test.ts && PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python -m pytest python/tests/test_contract_golden.py python/tests/test_api.py -q -o addopts=''
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix web run test -- --run --coverage && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs && PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python -m pytest python/tests -q && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix web run test:e2e
